newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Gold edges lower despite continued firm PGMs.
newsitem.headline: Gold edges lower despite continued firm PGMs.

text.p: Gold was a touch softer early on Thursday compared with the London close despite the continued extremely tight situation in platinum group metals.
Gold was quoted lower at $341.20/$341.70 an ounce compared with the London close of $342.10/$342.60. It was slightly higher than the New York close of $341.00/$341.50.
Traders said activity was thin and nervous after palladium bounded to 17-year highs on Wednesday.
"At the present moment people are keeping very quiet," said one trader.
Silver was also slightly lower at $4.72/$4.74 versus $4.75/$4.77 at the London close on Wednesday.
Palladium was lower as well at $225.00/$235.00 compared with $230.00/$240.00.
